author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: Equal-Quota Graph (Exact k=48) with Adaptive Residualization
abstract: Fixes balanced graph degree to exactly k_total: distribute q=floor(k/B) per batch plus r=k%B rotating extras per node. Combined with adaptive per-PC residualization (γ_j=min(0.74, 0.9·R²_j)) and ComBat-PCA64 embedding. Tests whether exact degree improves the composite score over EID 185 (0.7209).
